messages:
Diego: hey all, i'm Diego (day 1) 1 1 trying to map who to ping for different ownerships so i don't spam people. quick concrete asks: 1) who owns alerting rules and who modifies infra-level thresholds? 2) who approves SSO/Okta group additions for Dedicated console? 3) who gets paged for latency spikes vs model-quality drift? 4) short link to owner roster or cheat-sheet? thanks! :wave:

Fiona: welcome Diego 38944b. alerting rules for infra/capacity are owned by eng-platform (they manage cluster & routing alerts). app-level/model alerts are eng-ml. eng-sre owns the oncall runbooks and paging rules.

Tom: for approvals: SSO/Okta group changes -> Identity team (IT) + your manager. use the internal form or email `identity@redwood.com` with manager CC. Dedicated console group = `redwood-dedicated-users` (IT will add you once approved).

SRE-bot: Paging quick summary: P0/P1 perf/availability -> eng-sre oncall (pagerduty). eng-sre triages then escalates to eng-platform (capacity/routing), eng-runtime (OOMs/batching), or eng-ml (model quality). For model drift alerts tag @eng-ml and include the eval link if available.

Nora: added tip: for threshold changes on infra alerts open a small PR in infra-alerts repo and ping eng-platform for review. They prefer the PR + short rationale so alerts don't flip-flop. Also check /handbook/owners.md (small roster) and /playbooks/paging.md for runbooks.

Diego: can someone paste a minimal access request template i can drop into the IT form?

IT-bot: template below (paste into IT system):
```
Subject: Access Request: Dedicated Console / Okta Group - diego@example.com
Requester: Diego (diego@example.com)
Manager: <manager-name>
Role: Engineer
Environment: staging/prod
Requested Okta group: redwood-dedicated-users
Reason: Onboarding + need to monitor routing and alerts for feature B
Expected peak QPS: 100
Temp access: 48h (optional)
Approvers: manager + identity@redwood.com
```

Diego: filed the IT request and CC'd manager. super helpful 64f. one last q: if i see a customer-facing regression who do i page directly?

Fiona: page eng-sre oncall immediately and add `#customer-impact`. eng-sre will triage and loop in CS and the owning engineering team. if it's obvious model-quality (bad completions) also mention @eng-ml in the page body.

Diego: got it, thanks everyone. i'll read the playbooks and DM if approvals stall. :sparkles:
